content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am ready to move forward, but I would like to request a slight adjustment to the relevant clause before signing. - Regarding the clause '$ 115,250.00      Net ninety (90) days from the Effective Date of this Agreement.', a 90-day payment term creates a delay in cash flow, so I propose changing it to '$ 115,250.00      Net thirty (30) days from the Effective Date of this Agreement.'. Please let me know if this is acceptable. Best regards,
